fib: ______ is a property that determines how well the individual molecules in a solid fit together in a crystal lattice.
Packing
Packing is a property that determines how well the individual molecules in a solid fit together in a crystal lattice.
______ is the transformation of one chemical or collection of chemicals into another chemical or collection of chemicals.
chemical reaction
A chemical reaction is the transformation of one chemical or collection of chemicals into another chemical or collection of chemicals.
______ are used as colouring agents in crayons, pencils, and ink.
Amides
Amides are used as colouring agents in crayons, pencils, and ink.
______ is a group of atoms within a molecule that has a characteristic chemical behaviour.
functional group
A functional group is a group of atoms within a molecule that has a characteristic chemical behaviour.
______ is the reverse of an elimination reaction.
addition reaction
An addition reaction is the reverse of an elimination reaction.
______ is a carbon atom that is bonded to four different groups.
asymmetric carbon
An asymmetric carbon is a carbon atom that is bonded to four different groups.
______ are used instead of (+) and (-).
Sometimes lowercase d and l
Sometimes lowercase d and l are used instead of (+) and (-).
______ is an especially useful reaction because a nitro group can then be reduced to an NH2 group, a common benzene substituent.
Nitration

______ is used as a paint stripper and a solvent.
Methyl ethyl ketone
Methyl ethyl ketone is used as a paint stripper and a solvent.
______ is the number of degrees of rotation caused by a solution of 1.0 g of the compound per mL of solution in a sample tube 1.0 dm long at a specified temperature and wavelength.
specific rotation
The specific rotation is the number of degrees of rotation caused by a solution of 1.0 g of the compound per mL of solution in a sample tube 1.0 dm long at a specified temperature and wavelength.
______ is a detailed description of how bonds are broken and formed as a starting material is converted to a product.
reaction mechanism
A reaction mechanism is a detailed description of how bonds are broken and formed as a starting material is converted to a product.
______ is the replacement of one or more hydrogen atoms in an organic compound by a halogen (fluorine, chlorine, bromine or iodine).
Halogenation
Halogenation is the replacement of one or more hydrogen atoms in an organic compound by a halogen (fluorine, chlorine, bromine or iodine).
______ is a β blocker, a group of drugs used to treat hypertension.
Atenolol

______ is the molecule in which the carbonyl is bonded to two hydrogen atoms.
special aldehyde
A special aldehyde is the molecule in which the carbonyl is bonded to two hydrogen atoms.
